description: Two 1-minute bars on BTCUSDT-PERP. Bar 0 (bucketTs 0) has two price buckets with a bid/ask mix; bar 1 (bucketTs 60000) has one bucket. A tick lands exactly on the 60000 boundary and must belong to bar 1. closeExpired(60001) closes bar 0 only; drainAll closes bar 1. Asserts: per-cell bid+ask=total volume, trades=tick count, bar rollover emits cell.close, mid-bar deltas, CVD steps once per closed bar.
